module: GE extension that evaluates the unlock and visibility conditions of missions (startCondition and visibleCondition fields). On load, it loads all condition types from the gameplay/missions/unlocks/conditions/ folder. It also builds caches: previous missions (backward), next missions (forward), depth in the tree and required career branch level. A modder uses it to know whether a mission is startable/visible or to force these states.
usage:
local m = gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionById('west_coast_usa/timeTrials/xyz')
if gameplay_missions_unlocks.isMissionStartable(m) then ... end
gameplay_missions_unlocks.overrideStartable(m, true)
notes: M.startConditionMet is exported but references a nonexistent local variable: it is always nil (game bug).
Outside career, a mission shown in both career and freeroam is always startable and visible (computeStartableDetails returns nil).
Results are cached by mission id: call clearUnlockStatusCache() after a progress change.
A visibleCondition of type 'automatic' makes the mission visible if at least one previous mission is startable (or if there are none).
getBranchLevelForCondition calls M.getBranchLevelForCondition for recursion (not the local): no consequence as long as M is not replaced.
Overrides (overrideStartable / overrideVisible) take precedence over the computation and are never cleared by clearCache.

startConditionMet.desc: Exported from an undefined variable: always nil.

conditionMet.desc: Recursively evaluates a condition. Looks up the type among the loaded types (falls back to 'missing' if unknown), calls its conditionMet and its getLabel.

condition.desc: Condition with a type field (e.g. missionPassed, branchLevel, multiAnd) and its parameters.

returns.desc: {met = boolean, condition = table, nested = table|nil (results of the sub-conditions), label = string|table, hidden = boolean|nil}

getSimpleUnlockedStatus.desc: Builds a flat table (mission id -> deep copy of constructUnlocksField) to compare the unlock state before/after an action.

getUnlockDiff.desc: Compares two getSimpleUnlockedStatus results on the startable and visible keys.

returns.desc: {list = {{missionId, change = {{key, old, new}}}}, byId = table, missionsList = {{name, id}} (missions that became startable)}

getMissionBasedUnlockDiff.desc: For a mission, lists the missions it directly unlocks (forwardIds), with their startable state and whether they changed in diff.

getMissionsForCondition.desc: Recursively collects the mission ids referenced by the missionPassed and missionCompleted conditions.

getBranchLevelForCondition.desc: Recursively collects the required career branch levels (branchLevel conditions, and league via the league's branch, level 1).

list.desc: Table branchId -> level, filled in place.

isMissionStartable.desc: Indicates whether the mission is startable. An override set by overrideStartable takes precedence, otherwise the startCondition result is used.

getStartableDetails.desc: Details (cached) of the startCondition evaluation. Returns nil for a mission present in both career and freeroam when career is not active.

isMissionVisible.desc: Indicates whether the mission is visible (depending on career/freeroam mode and visibleCondition). An override set by overrideVisible takes precedence. Result cached.

getBackwardMissionIds.desc: Ids of the missions required by this mission's startCondition (cached).

getForwardMissionInfo.desc: Forward information: unlocked missions, max branch level, branch tags and depth. Rebuilds the full cache if needed (loads all missions).

returns.desc: {forwardIds = string[], maxBranchLevel = integer, branchTags = table<string, boolean>, depth = integer}

overrideStartable.desc: Forces a mission's startable state (nil to remove the override).

overrideVisible.desc: Forces a mission's visibility (nil to remove the override).

returns.desc: {startable, visible, startableDetails, backward, forward, maxBranchLevel, branchTags, depth}

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: loads all files from /lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/missions/unlocks/conditions and registers each condition type.

depthIdSort.desc: Comparator for table.sort on missions: by ascending depth then by id.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

depthIdSortUsingIds.desc: Like depthIdSort but from mission ids. Returns false if either mission does not exist.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

clearUnlockStatusCache.desc: Clears the startable/visible state cache (and the career leagues cache if present).

clearCache.desc: Clears the state cache as well as the backward and forward caches.
